chapter_seo_title: Dao Twisted World Chapter 466 – The Office Conspiracy, Zuowandao Purge & Li Huowang’s To-Do List
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang learns the truth behind the Shangjing Golden Palace Formation and the Office’s plan against the Heavenly Calamity. Liu Zongyuan brings news of an upcoming Zuowandao purge. Li Sui shows a new, dangerous aggression.
og_title: The Calamity Wasn’t for Immortality – It Was Survival
og_description: Li Huowang gets the real story behind the Office’s Shangjing formation: fighting a Heaven-Devouring Dog Eclipse, not feeding an emperor’s ego. Plus, the Zuowandao are about to get purged.
twitter_title: Blind Man’s Bluff and a Dog That Bites
twitter_description: Liu Zongyuan shows up with gossip about the Office’s plan, the Zuowandao’s next move, and a tip on eye replacements. Li Sui tries to eat him. Just another day in the Dao-Twisted World.

lore_anchors.definition: A catastrophic world-ending-style event caused by the corruption or malfunction of heavenly laws; the Heaven-Devouring Dog Eclipse is one such event.
A folk term for a solar eclipse, literalized here as a sentient, celestial dog that devours the sun; fighting it requires a formation and a divine artifact.
A powerful ritual formation erected by the Supervisory Heavenly Office using the Divine Mountain Ghost Eye; intended to counter the Heavenly Calamity.
A high-level artifact or entity used by the Office as the core of the Golden Palace Grand Formation; its purpose was to fight the eclipse.
A special spiritual constitution that makes a person a metaphysical node or bridge; Zhuge Yuan’s status was hijacked by the Zuowandao to link their branches.
Solidified years of lifespan used as currency by the Supervisory Heavenly Office; can be traded for techniques or magical tools in the official treasury.
